select
    date_day,
    extract(year from date_day) as year,
    extract(quarter from date_day) as quarter,
    extract(month from date_day) as month,
    format_date('%B', date_day) as month_name,
    extract(day from date_day) as day_of_month,
    mod(extract(dayofweek from date_day) + 5, 7) + 1 as iso_day_of_week,
    format_date('%A', date_day) as day_name,
    extract(dayofweek from date_day) in (1, 7) as is_weekend,
    date_trunc(date_day, isoweek) as iso_week_start
from unnest(
    generate_date_array(date '2025-01-01', date_add(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 60 day))
) as date_day

with base as (

),
deduped as (

            order by _ingested_at desc
        ) as tract_rank
    from base
)

with base as (
    select
        crash_id,
        event_ts_utc,
        severity,
        severity_text,
        lon,
        lat,
        roadway_name,
        on_route,
        off_route,
        bike_involved,
        ped_involved,
        _extract_date,
        _ingested_at
    from `whyline-denver`.`raw_denver`.`raw_crashes`
    where lon is not null
      and lat is not null
      -- Only the latest extract: Denver's five-year window as of that day. Older extracts would
      -- keep crashes that have aged out of the window. raw_crashes is partitioned by event date,
      -- so this subquery reads only recent partitions; the main scan still covers every extract.
      and _extract_date = (
          select max(_extract_date)
          from `whyline-denver`.`raw_denver`.`raw_crashes`
          where event_ts_utc >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval 60 day)
      )
),
deduped as (
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (
            partition by crash_id
            -- A crash listed twice in one extract: the latest load wins, fully ordered so reruns agree
            order by _extract_date desc, _ingested_at desc, event_ts_utc desc, severity desc, lon, lat
        ) as crash_rank
    from base
)
select
    crash_id,
    event_ts_utc,
    severity,
    severity_text,
    
    ST_GEOGPOINT(CAST(lon AS FLOAT64), CAST(lat AS FLOAT64))
 as geom,
    roadway_name,
    on_route,
    off_route,
    bike_involved,
    ped_involved,
    
    DATE(event_ts_utc, "America/Denver")
 as event_date_mst,
    
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM DATETIME(event_ts_utc, "America/Denver"))
 as event_hour_mst
from deduped
where crash_rank = 1

with versions as (
    
with versions_in as (
    select
        route_id,
        _extract_date,
        route_name, route_long_name, route_type, route_desc,
        to_json_string(struct(route_name, route_long_name, route_type, route_desc)) as attr_sig
    from (select * from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_gtfs_routes` where is_valid)
),
flagged as (
    select
        *,
        if(attr_sig = lag(attr_sig) over (partition by route_id order by _extract_date), 0, 1) as is_change
    from versions_in
),
numbered as (
    select
        *,
        sum(is_change) over (
            partition by route_id order by _extract_date rows unbounded preceding
        ) as version_num
    from flagged
),
grouped as (
    select
        route_id,
        version_num,
        any_value(route_name) as route_name,
        any_value(route_long_name) as route_long_name,
        any_value(route_type) as route_type,
        any_value(route_desc) as route_desc,
        min(_extract_date) as first_seen_extract,
        max(_extract_date) as last_seen_extract
    from numbered
    group by route_id, version_num
),
bounded as (
    select
        *,
        if(version_num = 1, date '1900-01-01', first_seen_extract) as valid_from,
        lead(first_seen_extract) over (partition by route_id order by version_num) as next_valid_from,
        max(last_seen_extract) over () as latest_extract
    from grouped
)
select
    farm_fingerprint(concat(cast(route_id as string), '|', cast(valid_from as string))) as route_key,
    route_id,
    route_name, route_long_name, route_type, route_desc,
    valid_from,
    case
        when next_valid_from is not null then date_sub(next_valid_from, interval 1 day)
        when last_seen_extract = latest_extract then date '9999-12-31'
        else last_seen_extract
    end as valid_to,
    next_valid_from is null and last_seen_extract = latest_extract as is_current,
    next_valid_from is null as is_latest_version,
    first_seen_extract,
    last_seen_extract
from bounded

)

select
    route_key,
    route_id,
    route_name,
    route_long_name,
    route_type,

with calendar as (
    select * from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_gtfs_calendar` where _extract_date >= date '2026-10-31'
),
calendar_dates as (
    select * from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_gtfs_calendar_dates` where _extract_date >= date '2026-10-31'
),
trips as (
    select _extract_date, trip_id, route_id, direction_id, service_id, is_valid
    from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_gtfs_trips`
    where _extract_date >= date '2026-10-31'
),
stop_times as (
    select _extract_date, trip_id, stop_id, stop_sequence, arrival_time, departure_time, is_valid
    from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_gtfs_stop_times`
    where _extract_date >= date '2026-10-31'
),
file_extracts as (
    select
        'calendar' as gtfs_file,
        _extract_date,
        logical_and(is_valid) as all_valid,
        logical_or(is_valid) as any_valid
    from calendar
    group by _extract_date
    union all
    select
        'calendar_dates' as gtfs_file,
        _extract_date,
        logical_and(is_valid) as all_valid,
        logical_or(is_valid) as any_valid
    from calendar_dates
    group by _extract_date
    union all
    select
        'trips' as gtfs_file,
        _extract_date,
        logical_and(is_valid) as all_valid,
        logical_or(is_valid) as any_valid
    from trips
    group by _extract_date
    union all
    select
        'stop_times' as gtfs_file,
        _extract_date,
        logical_and(is_valid) as all_valid,
        logical_or(is_valid) as any_valid
    from stop_times
    group by _extract_date
),
good_snapshots as (
    select _extract_date
    from file_extracts
    group by _extract_date
    having logical_and(all_valid)
),
date_candidates as (
    select
        service_date,
        max(if(g._extract_date <= service_date, g._extract_date, null)) as prev_snapshot,
        min(if(g._extract_date > service_date, g._extract_date, null)) as next_snapshot
    from unnest(generate_date_array(
        current_date('America/Denver'),
        date_add(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 30 day)
    )) as service_date
    cross join good_snapshots as g
    group by service_date
),
date_snapshot as (
    -- Preference 1: latest snapshot on or before the date; 2: the next one
    select
        dc.service_date,
        candidate.snapshot_date,
        candidate.preference
    from date_candidates as dc
    cross join unnest([
        struct(dc.prev_snapshot as snapshot_date, 1 as preference),
        struct(dc.next_snapshot as snapshot_date, 2 as preference)
    ]) as candidate
    where candidate.snapshot_date is not null
),
date_extract as (
    -- Per file: latest valid extract on or before the snapshot (unchanged files are not reloaded)
    select
        ds.service_date,
        ds.preference,
        coalesce(
            max(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'calendar' and fe.any_valid and fe._extract_date <= ds.snapshot_date, fe._extract_date, null)),
            min(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'calendar' and fe.any_valid, fe._extract_date, null))
        ) as calendar_extract,
        coalesce(
            max(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'calendar_dates' and fe.any_valid and fe._extract_date <= ds.snapshot_date, fe._extract_date, null)),
            min(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'calendar_dates' and fe.any_valid, fe._extract_date, null))
        ) as calendar_dates_extract,
        coalesce(
            max(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'trips' and fe.any_valid and fe._extract_date <= ds.snapshot_date, fe._extract_date, null)),
            min(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'trips' and fe.any_valid, fe._extract_date, null))
        ) as trips_extract,
        coalesce(
            max(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'stop_times' and fe.any_valid and fe._extract_date <= ds.snapshot_date, fe._extract_date, null)),
            min(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'stop_times' and fe.any_valid, fe._extract_date, null))
        ) as stop_times_extract
    from date_snapshot as ds
    cross join file_extracts as fe
    group by ds.service_date, ds.preference
),
active_services as (
    select
        de.service_date,
        de.preference,
        de.trips_extract,
        de.stop_times_extract,
        c.service_id
    from date_extract as de
    join calendar as c
        on c._extract_date = de.calendar_extract
        and c.is_valid
        and de.service_date between c.start_date and c.end_date
        and case extract(dayofweek from de.service_date)
            when 1 then c.sunday
            when 2 then c.monday
            when 3 then c.tuesday
            when 4 then c.wednesday
            when 5 then c.thursday
            when 6 then c.friday
            when 7 then c.saturday
        end
    left join calendar_dates as removed
        on removed._extract_date = de.calendar_dates_extract
        and removed.service_id = c.service_id
        and removed.exception_date = de.service_date
        and removed.exception_type = 2
        and removed.is_valid
    where removed.service_id is null

    union distinct

    select
        de.service_date,
        de.preference,
        de.trips_extract,
        de.stop_times_extract,
        cd.service_id
    from date_extract as de
    join calendar_dates as cd
        on cd._extract_date = de.calendar_dates_extract
        and cd.exception_date = de.service_date
        and cd.exception_type = 1
        and cd.is_valid
),
chosen_services as (
    -- Use the next snapshot only when the preferred one runs no service that day
    select *
    from active_services
    qualify preference = min(preference) over (partition by service_date)
),
expanded as (
    select
        a.service_date,
        a.stop_times_extract,
        t.trip_id,
        t.route_id,
        t.direction_id,
        st.stop_id,
        st.stop_sequence,
        case
            when st.arrival_time is not null
                then 
timestamp(
    datetime(
        date_add(
            a.service_date,
            interval cast(floor(
                safe_cast(split(st.arrival_time, ':')[offset(0)] as int64) / 24
            ) as int64) day
        ),
        time(
            mod(
                safe_cast(split(st.arrival_time, ':')[offset(0)] as int64),
                24
            ),
            safe_cast(split(st.arrival_time, ':')[offset(1)] as int64),
            safe_cast(split(st.arrival_time, ':')[offset(2)] as int64)
        )
    ),
    "America/Denver"
)

        end as sched_arrival_ts_mst,
        case
            when st.departure_time is not null
                then 
timestamp(
    datetime(
        date_add(
            a.service_date,
            interval cast(floor(
                safe_cast(split(st.departure_time, ':')[offset(0)] as int64) / 24
            ) as int64) day
        ),
        time(
            mod(
                safe_cast(split(st.departure_time, ':')[offset(0)] as int64),

            ),
            safe_cast(split(st.departure_time, ':')[offset(1)] as int64),
            safe_cast(split(st.departure_time, ':')[offset(2)] as int64)
        )
    ),
    "America/Denver"
)

        end as sched_departure_ts_mst
    from chosen_services as a
    join trips as t
        on t._extract_date = a.trips_extract
        and t.service_id = a.service_id
        and t.is_valid
    join stop_times as st
        on st._extract_date = a.stop_times_extract
        and st.trip_id = t.trip_id
        and st.is_valid
)

-- One-off export for the stop-visit backfill (owner-run; writes Parquet to GCS, creates no tables).
-- Compile: dbt compile --select backfill_export
--          --vars '{stream_start_date: "YYYY-MM-DD", backfill_export_uri: "gs://BUCKET/backfill/export"}'
-- Run:     bq query --use_legacy_sql=false < dbt/target/compiled/whyline_denver_dbt/analyses/backfill_export.sql
-- Then:    python -m whyline.ingest.gtfs_rt_backfill --export <uri> --from 2025-10-23 --until <stream start - 1>
-- Dry runs (2026-10-28): old trip updates 11.2 GiB and vehicle positions 0.8 GiB over the whole range
-- (about 0.08 GiB per daily statement), schedule extract per date 1.7 GiB, ingestion log 0.01 GiB, static
-- extracts about 0.06 GiB per distinct feed version. With the 10 MB minimum on each of the ~740 daily
-- statements, about 19 GiB in all, inside the monthly free tier. Runtime: roughly 1-2 hours.
DECLARE start_date DATE DEFAULT DATE '2025-10-23';
DECLARE end_date DATE DEFAULT DATE_SUB(DATE '2100-01-01', INTERVAL 1 DAY);
DECLARE uri STRING DEFAULT 'gs://SET-ME';
DECLARE extracts ARRAY<DATE>;

IF STARTS_WITH(uri, 'gs://SET-ME') OR end_date >= CURRENT_DATE() THEN
    RAISE USING MESSAGE = 'Set stream_start_date (first full stream day) and backfill_export_uri.';
END IF;

-- Static GTFS: the extract the schedule used on each service date, each file at its latest load on or
-- before that extract, deduplicated by file content (ingestion-log hashes) so an unchanged feed exports once.
CREATE TEMP TABLE file_hashes AS
SELECT
    `table` AS tbl,
    SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', REGEXP_EXTRACT(_source_path, r'extract_date=(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})')) AS file_extract,
    ANY_VALUE(_hash_md5) AS hash
FROM `whyline-denver.raw_denver.__ingestion_log`
WHERE `table` IN ('raw_gtfs_stops', 'raw_gtfs_routes', 'raw_gtfs_trips', 'raw_gtfs_stop_times', 'raw_gtfs_shapes')
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING file_extract IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TEMP TABLE service_extract AS
SELECT service_date_mst AS service_date, ANY_VALUE(gtfs_extract_date) AS extract_date
FROM `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_scheduled_stop_time`
WHERE service_date_mst BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
GROUP BY 1;

CREATE TEMP TABLE version_files AS
SELECT e.extract_date, f.tbl, MAX(f.file_extract) AS file_extract
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT extract_date FROM service_extract) AS e
JOIN file_hashes AS f ON f.file_extract <= e.extract_date
GROUP BY 1, 2;

CREATE TEMP TABLE versions AS
SELECT extract_date, MIN(extract_date) OVER (PARTITION BY content) AS static_version
FROM (
    SELECT v.extract_date, TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(v.tbl, h.hash) ORDER BY v.tbl)) AS content
    FROM version_files AS v
    JOIN file_hashes AS h ON h.tbl = v.tbl AND h.file_extract = v.file_extract
    GROUP BY 1
);

EXECUTE IMMEDIATE FORMAT("""
EXPORT DATA OPTIONS (uri = '%s/service_static/*.parquet', format = 'PARQUET', overwrite = true) AS
SELECT s.service_date, v.static_version
FROM service_extract AS s JOIN versions AS v USING (extract_date)""", uri);

EXECUTE IMMEDIATE FORMAT("""
EXPORT DATA OPTIONS (uri = '%s/version_files/*.parquet', format = 'PARQUET', overwrite = true) AS
SELECT DISTINCT v.static_version, f.tbl, f.file_extract
FROM versions AS v JOIN version_files AS f ON f.extract_date = v.static_version""", uri);

-- Only the extracts the representative versions use, as a literal list so partitions prune.
FOR t IN (
    SELECT 'stops' AS name, 'raw_gtfs_stops' AS tbl, 'stop_id, stop_lat, stop_lon' AS cols
    UNION ALL SELECT 'routes', 'raw_gtfs_routes', 'route_id, route_type'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'trips', 'raw_gtfs_trips', 'trip_id, route_id, direction_id, shape_id, trip_headsign'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'stop_times', 'raw_gtfs_stop_times', 'trip_id, stop_sequence, stop_id, shape_dist_traveled'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'shapes', 'raw_gtfs_shapes', 'shape_id, shape_pt_lat, shape_pt_lon, shape_pt_sequence, shape_dist_traveled'
) DO
    SET extracts = (
        SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT f.file_extract)
        FROM versions AS v JOIN version_files AS f ON f.extract_date = v.static_version
        WHERE f.tbl = t.tbl
    );
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE FORMAT("""
    EXPORT DATA OPTIONS (uri = '%s/static/%s/*.parquet', format = 'PARQUET', overwrite = true) AS
    SELECT _extract_date, %s
    FROM `whyline-denver.raw_denver.%s`
    WHERE _extract_date IN UNNEST(%T)""", uri, t.name, t.cols, t.tbl, extracts);
END FOR;

-- The old 15-minute snapshots, one directory per UTC day so the backfill reads them in order.
FOR d IN (SELECT day FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(start_date, end_date)) AS day) DO
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE FORMAT("""
    EXPORT DATA OPTIONS (uri = '%s/tu/date=%t/*.parquet', format = 'PARQUET', overwrite = true) AS
    SELECT feed_ts_utc, trip_id, route_id, stop_id, stop_sequence, schedule_relationship, event_ts_utc, start_date
    FROM `whyline-denver`.`raw_denver`.`raw_gtfsrt_trip_updates`
    WHERE DATE(feed_ts_utc) = %T""", uri, d.day, d.day);
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE FORMAT("""
    EXPORT DATA OPTIONS (uri = '%s/vp/date=%t/*.parquet', format = 'PARQUET', overwrite = true) AS
    SELECT feed_ts_utc, trip_id, route_id, vehicle_id, lon, lat, event_ts_utc
    FROM `whyline-denver`.`raw_denver`.`raw_gtfsrt_vehicle_positions`
    WHERE DATE(feed_ts_utc) = %T""", uri, d.day, d.day);
END FOR;

with batch as (
    select *
    from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_rt_stop_visits`
    where service_date >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
    
      and data_version != 'backfill_v1'
      
      and _ingested_at >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval 6 hour)
      
    
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by service_date, trip_id, stop_sequence
        order by emitted_at desc, _ingested_at desc
    ) = 1
),
new_visits as (
    select b.*
    from batch as b
    
    where not exists (
        select 1
        from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_stop_visit` as f
        where f.service_date >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
          and f.service_date = b.service_date
          and f.trip_id = b.trip_id
          and f.stop_sequence = b.stop_sequence
    )
    
),
schedule as (
    -- Same service-date bound as the batch, so BigQuery prunes the schedule partitions.
    select
        service_date_mst as service_date,
        trip_id,
        stop_sequence,
        stop_id,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        trip_key,
        route_key,
        stop_key,
        sched_arrival_ts_mst,
        sched_departure_ts_mst,
        timestamp_diff(
            coalesce(sched_arrival_ts_mst, sched_departure_ts_mst),
            lag(coalesce(sched_arrival_ts_mst, sched_departure_ts_mst)) over (
                partition by service_date_mst, route_id, direction_id, stop_id
                order by coalesce(sched_arrival_ts_mst, sched_departure_ts_mst), trip_id
            ),
            second
        ) as scheduled_headway_sec
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_scheduled_stop_time`
    where service_date_mst >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
      and service_date_mst <= current_date('America/Denver')
),
conformed as (
    select
        v.*,
        s.trip_key,
        s.route_key,
        s.stop_key,
        s.sched_arrival_ts_mst as scheduled_arrival_ts,
        s.sched_departure_ts_mst as scheduled_departure_ts,
        s.scheduled_headway_sec,
        -- The origin's event is its departure; elsewhere, the arrival.
        if(
            v.stop_role = 'first',
            coalesce(s.sched_departure_ts_mst, s.sched_arrival_ts_mst),
            coalesce(s.sched_arrival_ts_mst, s.sched_departure_ts_mst)
        ) as scheduled_event_ts
    from new_visits as v
    left join schedule as s
        on s.service_date = v.service_date
        and s.trip_id = v.trip_id
        and s.stop_sequence = v.stop_sequence
)

select
    farm_fingerprint(concat(
        cast(service_date as string), '|', trip_id, '|', cast(stop_sequence as string)
    )) as stop_visit_key,
    service_date,
    trip_id,
    stop_sequence,
    stop_id,
    stop_role,
    route_id,
    direction_id,
    trip_headsign,
    vehicle_id,
    coalesce(trip_key, -1) as trip_key,
    coalesce(route_key, -1) as route_key,
    coalesce(stop_key, -1) as stop_key,
    arrival_ts_utc,
    arrival_earliest_ts,
    arrival_latest_ts,
    
    DATETIME(arrival_ts_utc, "America/Denver")
 as arrival_ts_mst,
    
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM DATETIME(arrival_ts_utc, "America/Denver"))
 as arrival_hour_mst,
    departure_earliest_ts,
    departure_latest_ts,
    dwell_min_sec,
    dwell_max_sec,
    arrival_method,
    timestamp_diff(arrival_latest_ts, arrival_earliest_ts, second) as arrival_window_sec,
    timestamp_diff(arrival_latest_ts, arrival_earliest_ts, second) <= 30 as within_30s,
    scheduled_arrival_ts,
    scheduled_departure_ts,
    scheduled_headway_sec,
    -- NULL when either side is unknown; marts exclude unknown delays from on-time shares.
    timestamp_diff(arrival_ts_utc, scheduled_event_ts, second) as delay_sec,
    skipped,

--    and run the compiled SQL. Record the results in docs/public/METRICS_GLOSSARY.md before publishing
--    backfilled metrics.
-- Ground truth: stream shape_crossing visits (bracketing reports at most 30 s apart).
-- error_sec = backfill-method estimate minus stream estimate (positive: the backfill runs late).



with stream as (
    select service_date, trip_id, stop_sequence, route_id, arrival_ts_utc, arrival_hour_mst
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_stop_visit`
    where service_date between date '2100-01-01' and date '2100-01-01'
      and data_version = 'stream_v1'
      and arrival_method = 'shape_crossing'
),
thinned as (
    select service_date, trip_id, stop_sequence, arrival_ts_utc, arrival_method, low_confidence,
        timestamp_diff(arrival_latest_ts, arrival_earliest_ts, second) as window_sec
    from `whyline-denver`.`raw_denver`.`raw_gtfsrt_stop_visits_calibration`
    where service_date between date '2100-01-01' and date '2100-01-01'
      and arrival_ts_utc is not null
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by service_date, trip_id, stop_sequence order by _ingested_at desc
    ) = 1
),
paired as (
    select
        s.*,
        coalesce(t.arrival_method, 'not_recovered') as backfill_method,
        t.low_confidence,
        t.window_sec,
        timestamp_diff(t.arrival_ts_utc, s.arrival_ts_utc, second) as error_sec
    from stream as s
    left join thinned as t using (service_date, trip_id, stop_sequence)
)

select
    coalesce(backfill_method, 'all') as backfill_method,
    count(*) as n_stream_visits,
    round(count(*) / (select count(*) from stream), 4) as share_of_stream_visits,
    approx_quantiles(abs(error_sec), 100)[offset(50)] as median_abs_error_sec,
    approx_quantiles(abs(error_sec), 100)[offset(90)] as p90_abs_error_sec,
    round(avg(error_sec), 1) as bias_sec,
    approx_quantiles(window_sec, 100)[offset(50)] as median_window_sec,
    countif(low_confidence) as n_low_confidence
from paired
group by rollup (backfill_method)
order by n_stream_visits desc

with visits as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        stop_sequence,
        stop_id,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        arrival_method,
        arrival_ts_utc
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_stop_visit`
    where
        service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 3 day) and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
        and arrival_method in ('shape_crossing', 'shape_crossing_gap')
        and within_30s
        and arrival_ts_utc is not null
),
horizons as (
    select horizon_min from unnest([1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30]) as horizon_min
),
targets as (
    select
        v.*,
        h.horizon_min,
        timestamp_sub(v.arrival_ts_utc, interval h.horizon_min minute) as as_of_ts
    from visits as v
    cross join horizons as h
),
changes as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        stop_sequence,
        feed_ts_utc,
        change_type,
        predicted_ts_utc
    from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_rt_prediction_changes`
    where
        not is_trip_level
        -- Constant bounds so BigQuery prunes the raw partitions. A service day runs from about
        -- 10:00 UTC to 10:00 UTC the next day; predictions start a few hours before a trip.
        and feed_ts_utc >= timestamp(date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 3 day))
        and feed_ts_utc < timestamp(date_add(date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day), interval 2 day))
),
as_of as (
    select
        t.*,
        c.change_type,
        c.predicted_ts_utc,
        c.feed_ts_utc as prediction_made_ts
    from targets as t
    left join changes as c
        on c.service_date = t.service_date
        and c.trip_id = t.trip_id
        and c.stop_sequence = t.stop_sequence
        and c.feed_ts_utc <= t.as_of_ts
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by t.service_date, t.trip_id, t.stop_sequence, t.horizon_min
        order by c.feed_ts_utc desc
    ) = 1
),
predicted as (
    select
        *,
        coalesce(change_type, 'dropped') != 'dropped' and predicted_ts_utc is not null as has_prediction
    from as_of
),
scored as (
    select
        *,
        if(has_prediction, timestamp_diff(predicted_ts_utc, as_of_ts, second), null) as countdown_sec,
        if(has_prediction, timestamp_diff(arrival_ts_utc, predicted_ts_utc, second), null) as error_sec
    from predicted
),
bucketed as (
    select
        *,
        -- With no prediction on screen, bucket by the true time to arrival instead.
        case
            when coalesce(countdown_sec, horizon_min * 60) < 180 then '0-3'
            when coalesce(countdown_sec, horizon_min * 60) < 360 then '3-6'
            when coalesce(countdown_sec, horizon_min * 60) < 720 then '6-12'
            else '12-30'
        end as horizon_bucket
    from scored
)

select
    service_date,
    trip_id,
    stop_sequence,
    stop_id,
    route_id,
    direction_id,
    horizon_min,
    horizon_bucket,
    has_prediction,
    if(has_prediction, prediction_made_ts, null) as prediction_made_ts,
    if(has_prediction, predicted_ts_utc, null) as predicted_arrival_ts,
    arrival_ts_utc as actual_arrival_ts,
    arrival_method,
    countdown_sec,
    error_sec,
    case horizon_bucket
        when '0-3' then error_sec between -60 and 60
        when '3-6' then error_sec between -90 and 120
        when '6-12' then error_sec between -150 and 210
        else error_sec between -240 and 360
    end as within_band
from bucketed

with visits as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        stop_sequence,
        stop_id,
        within_30s,
        stop_dist_m,
        arrival_ts_utc,
        if(
            stop_role != 'first' and departure_earliest_ts is not null,
            timestamp_add(
                departure_earliest_ts,
                interval (div(timestamp_diff(departure_latest_ts, departure_earliest_ts, second), 2)) second
            ),
            arrival_ts_utc
        ) as depart_ts_utc,
        coalesce(scheduled_departure_ts, scheduled_arrival_ts) as scheduled_depart_ts,
        coalesce(scheduled_arrival_ts, scheduled_departure_ts) as scheduled_arrive_ts
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_stop_visit`
    where service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 3 day) and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
),
pairs as (
    select
        *,
        lead(stop_sequence) over trip_order as to_stop_sequence,
        lead(stop_id) over trip_order as to_stop_id,
        lead(within_30s) over trip_order as to_within_30s,
        lead(stop_dist_m) over trip_order as to_stop_dist_m,
        lead(arrival_ts_utc) over trip_order as arrive_ts_utc,
        lead(scheduled_arrive_ts) over trip_order as to_scheduled_arrive_ts
    from visits
    window trip_order as (partition by service_date, trip_id order by stop_sequence)
)

select
    service_date,
    trip_id,
    route_id,
    direction_id,
    stop_sequence as from_stop_sequence,
    stop_id as from_stop_id,
    to_stop_sequence,
    to_stop_id,
    case format_date('%u', service_date)
        when '6' then 'saturday'
        when '7' then 'sunday'
        else 'weekday'
    end as day_type,
    
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM DATETIME(depart_ts_utc, "America/Denver"))
 as depart_hour_mst,
    depart_ts_utc,
    arrive_ts_utc,
    timestamp_diff(arrive_ts_utc, depart_ts_utc, second) as travel_sec,
    timestamp_diff(to_scheduled_arrive_ts, scheduled_depart_ts, second) as scheduled_travel_sec,
    to_stop_dist_m - stop_dist_m as distance_m,
    round(safe_divide(3.6 * (to_stop_dist_m - stop_dist_m), timestamp_diff(arrive_ts_utc, depart_ts_utc, second)), 1)
        as speed_kmh
from pairs
where
    within_30s
    and to_within_30s
    and route_id is not null
    and to_stop_dist_m > stop_dist_m
    -- Whole seconds, so a sub-second traversal can't divide by zero.
    and timestamp_diff(arrive_ts_utc, depart_ts_utc, second) > 0
    -- Timing error on stops a few seconds apart yields impossible speeds (0.7% over 120 km/h).
    and safe_divide(3.6 * (to_stop_dist_m - stop_dist_m), timestamp_diff(arrive_ts_utc, depart_ts_utc, second)) <= 130

with visits as (
    select
        v.service_date,
        v.stop_id,
        v.route_id,
        v.direction_id,
        v.trip_id,
        v.stop_sequence,
        v.arrival_method,
        v.arrival_ts_utc,
        v.scheduled_headway_sec,
        v.delay_sec,
        lag(v.arrival_ts_utc) over (
            partition by v.service_date, v.route_id, v.direction_id, v.stop_id
            order by v.arrival_ts_utc, v.trip_id
        ) as previous_arrival_ts
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_stop_visit` as v
    left join `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_trip_status` as t
        on t.service_date = v.service_date
        and t.trip_id = v.trip_id
        and t.service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 3 day) and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
    where
        v.service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 3 day) and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
        and v.arrival_ts_utc is not null
        and (
            v.arrival_method in ('shape_crossing', 'shape_crossing_gap', 'origin_departure')
            or (v.arrival_method = 'last_prediction' and coalesce(t.had_vehicle, false))
        )
)

select
    service_date,
    stop_id,
    route_id,
    direction_id,
    trip_id,
    stop_sequence,
    arrival_method,
    arrival_ts_utc,
    case format_date('%u', service_date)
        when '6' then 'saturday'
        when '7' then 'sunday'
        else 'weekday'
    end as day_type,
    case
        when 
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM DATETIME(arrival_ts_utc, "America/Denver"))
 between 4 and 6 then 'early'
        when 
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM DATETIME(arrival_ts_utc, "America/Denver"))
 between 7 and 8 then 'am_peak'
        when 
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM DATETIME(arrival_ts_utc, "America/Denver"))
 between 9 and 14 then 'midday'
        when 
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM DATETIME(arrival_ts_utc, "America/Denver"))
 between 15 and 17 then 'pm_peak'
        when 
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM DATETIME(arrival_ts_utc, "America/Denver"))
 between 18 and 20 then 'evening'
        else 'night'
    end as period,
    timestamp_diff(arrival_ts_utc, previous_arrival_ts, second) as observed_headway_sec,
    scheduled_headway_sec,
    delay_sec
from visits
where route_id is not null

with visits as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        stop_sequence,
        stop_id,
        stop_role,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        stop_dist_m,
        -- The first stop's arrival holds its departure; skipped stops fall back to the schedule.
        coalesce(arrival_ts_utc, scheduled_arrival_ts) as event_ts_utc
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_stop_visit`
    where service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 3 day) and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
),
reports as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        vehicle_id,
        report_ts_utc,
        stop_id,
        dist_along_m,
        case occupancy_status
            when 'EMPTY' then 1
            when 'MANY_SEATS_AVAILABLE' then 1
            when 'FEW_SEATS_AVAILABLE' then 2
            when 'STANDING_ROOM_ONLY' then 3
            when 'CRUSHED_STANDING_ROOM_ONLY' then 4
            when 'FULL' then 5
        end as level
    from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_rt_vehicle_positions`
    where
        -- Constant bounds so BigQuery prunes the raw partitions (see fct_prediction_accuracy).
        feed_ts_utc >= timestamp(date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 3 day))
        and feed_ts_utc < timestamp(date_add(date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day), interval 2 day))
        and valid_for_timing
        and stop_id is not null
),
matched as (
    select
        r.service_date,
        r.trip_id,
        v.stop_sequence,
        r.report_ts_utc,
        r.level
    from reports as r
    join visits as v
        on v.service_date = r.service_date
        and v.trip_id = r.trip_id
        and v.stop_id = r.stop_id
        and v.stop_dist_m >= r.dist_along_m - 50
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by r.service_date, r.trip_id, r.vehicle_id, r.report_ts_utc
        order by v.stop_sequence
    ) = 1
),
by_stop as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        stop_sequence,
        count(*) as n_reports,
        countif(level is not null) as n_reports_with_data,
        max(level) as max_level,
        min(report_ts_utc) as first_report_ts
    from matched
    group by 1, 2, 3
)

select
    v.service_date,
    v.trip_id,
    v.stop_sequence,
    v.stop_id,
    v.stop_role,
    v.route_id,
    v.direction_id,
    v.event_ts_utc,
    coalesce(b.n_reports, 0) as n_reports,
    coalesce(b.n_reports_with_data, 0) as n_reports_with_data,
    b.max_level,
    case b.max_level
        when 1 then 'many_seats'
        when 2 then 'few_seats'
        when 3 then 'standing_room_only'
        when 4 then 'crushed_standing_room_only'
        when 5 then 'full'
    end as max_level_label,
    b.first_report_ts
from visits as v
left join by_stop as b
    on b.service_date = v.service_date
    and b.trip_id = v.trip_id
    and b.stop_sequence = v.stop_sequence

with e as (
    select
        route_id,
        service_date as service_date_mst,
        delay_sec,
        arrival_method,
        arrival_window_sec,
        within_30s,
        skipped,
        data_version
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_stop_visit`
    -- Unassigned visits remain in the fact (route_key -1) but cannot contribute to route metrics.
    where route_id is not null
      and data_version in ('stream_v1')
      -- The poller started early on 2026-10-29, so the service date before holds only a few late
      -- trips; rebuilding that date would replace its full legacy partition with them.
      and service_date >= '2026-10-29'
    
        and service_date >= date_sub(current_date("America/Denver"), interval 30 day)
    
),
w as (
    select
        weather_date as service_date_mst,
        precip_bin,
        snow_day,
        precip_mm,
        snow_mm,
        tmin_c,
        tmax_c
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_weather_daily`
    where station = 'USW00003017'
),
canceled as (
    select
        route_id,
        service_date as service_date_mst,
        countif(outcome = 'canceled') as n_canceled_trips
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_trip_status`
    where route_id is not null
      and data_version in ('stream_v1')
    
        and service_date >= date_sub(current_date("America/Denver"), interval 30 day)
    
    group by route_id, service_date_mst
),
scheduled as (
    -- The schedule fact runs 30 days ahead, so the upper bound keeps the scan to the window.
    select
        route_id,
        service_date_mst,
        count(*) as n_scheduled
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_scheduled_stop_time`
    where service_date_mst <= current_date("America/Denver")
    
        and service_date_mst >= date_sub(current_date("America/Denver"), interval 30 day)
    
    group by route_id, service_date_mst
),
agg as (
    select
        e.route_id,
        e.service_date_mst,
        coalesce(w.precip_bin, 'unknown') as precip_bin,
        w.snow_day as snow_day,
        countif(not skipped) as n_events,
        countif(delay_sec is not null) as n_reported_events,
        avg(
            case
                when delay_sec is null then null
                when delay_sec > -60
                    and delay_sec <= 300 then 1
                else 0
            end
        ) as pct_on_time,
        avg(delay_sec) as mean_delay_sec,
        approx_quantiles(delay_sec, 100)[offset(50)] as median_delay_sec,
        approx_quantiles(delay_sec, 100)[offset(90)] as p90_delay_sec,
        current_timestamp() as build_run_at,
        if(count(distinct data_version) > 1, 'mixed', any_value(data_version)) as data_version,
        countif(skipped) as n_skipped,
        safe_divide(
            countif(arrival_method like '%crossing%' or arrival_method = 'origin_departure'),
            countif(not skipped)
        ) as pct_shape_crossing,
        safe_divide(countif(arrival_method like '%prediction%'), countif(not skipped)) as pct_last_prediction,
        safe_divide(countif(within_30s), countif(not skipped)) as pct_within_30s,
        approx_quantiles(arrival_window_sec, 100)[offset(50)] as median_window_sec,
        any_value(w.precip_mm) as precip_mm,
        any_value(w.snow_mm) as snow_mm,
        any_value(w.tmin_c) as tmin_c,
        any_value(w.tmax_c) as tmax_c
    from e
    left join w
        using (service_date_mst)
    group by
        route_id,
        service_date_mst,
        precip_bin,
        snow_day
)

select
    agg.* except (
        data_version, n_skipped, pct_shape_crossing, pct_last_prediction, pct_within_30s,
        median_window_sec, precip_mm, snow_mm, tmin_c, tmax_c
    ),
    r.route_name,
    r.route_long_name,
    agg.data_version,
    agg.n_skipped,
    coalesce(c.n_canceled_trips, 0) as n_canceled_trips,
    s.n_scheduled,
    -- Every visit that isn't skipped has an arrival, so a known delay marks an observed,
    -- scheduled stop event.
    safe_divide(agg.n_reported_events, s.n_scheduled) as pct_observed,
    agg.pct_shape_crossing,
    agg.pct_last_prediction,
    agg.pct_within_30s,
    agg.median_window_sec,
    agg.precip_mm,
    agg.snow_mm,
    agg.tmin_c,
    agg.tmax_c,
    -- The same bands as mart_weather_impacts_hourly, on the day's mean temperature.
    case
        when (agg.tmin_c + agg.tmax_c) / 2 < -10 then 'below_-10'
        when (agg.tmin_c + agg.tmax_c) / 2 < 0 then '-10_to_0'
        when (agg.tmin_c + agg.tmax_c) / 2 < 30 then '0_to_30'
        when (agg.tmin_c + agg.tmax_c) / 2 >= 30 then '30_plus'
    end as temp_band
from agg
left join canceled as c
    on c.route_id = agg.route_id
    and c.service_date_mst = agg.service_date_mst
left join scheduled as s
    on s.route_id = agg.route_id
    and s.service_date_mst = agg.service_date_mst
left join `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`dim_route` as r
    on r.route_id = agg.route_id
    and r.is_latest_version

with base as (
    select
        stop_id,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        service_date as service_date_mst,
        arrival_hour_mst as event_hour_mst,
        arrival_ts_utc,
        delay_sec,
        scheduled_headway_sec,
        arrival_method,
        within_30s,
        data_version
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_stop_visit`
    where stop_id is not null
      and arrival_ts_utc is not null
      and data_version in ('stream_v1')
      -- The poller started early on 2026-10-29, so the service date before holds only a few late
      -- trips; rebuilding that date would replace its full legacy partition with them.
      and service_date >= '2026-10-29'
    
        and service_date >= date_sub(current_date("America/Denver"), interval 1 day)
    
),
headways as (
    select
        *,
        timestamp_diff(
            arrival_ts_utc,
            lag(arrival_ts_utc) over (
                partition by stop_id, route_id, direction_id, service_date_mst
                order by arrival_ts_utc
            ),
            second
        ) as obs_headway_sec
    from base
),
head as (
    select
        stop_id,
        service_date_mst,
        event_hour_mst,
        avg(
            case
                when obs_headway_sec is null
                    or scheduled_headway_sec is null
                    or scheduled_headway_sec <= 0 then null
                when abs(obs_headway_sec - scheduled_headway_sec) / scheduled_headway_sec
                    <= 0.5 then 1
                else 0
            end
        ) as headway_adherence_rate,
        approx_quantiles(obs_headway_sec, 100)[offset(50)] as obs_headway_sec_p50,
        approx_quantiles(obs_headway_sec, 100)[offset(90)] as obs_headway_sec_p90
    from headways
    group by
        stop_id,
        service_date_mst,
        event_hour_mst
),
agg as (
    select
        stop_id,
        service_date_mst,
        event_hour_mst,
        count(*) as n_events,
        avg(
            case
                when delay_sec is null then null
                when delay_sec > -60
                    and delay_sec <= 300 then 1
                else 0
            end
        ) as pct_on_time,
        avg(delay_sec) as mean_delay_sec,
        approx_quantiles(delay_sec, 100)[offset(90)] as p90_delay_sec,
        if(count(distinct data_version) > 1, 'mixed', any_value(data_version)) as data_version,
        countif(delay_sec is not null) as n_reported_events,
        safe_divide(countif(within_30s), count(*)) as pct_within_30s,
        safe_divide(
            countif(arrival_method like '%crossing%' or arrival_method = 'origin_departure'),
            count(*)
        ) as pct_shape_crossing
    from base
    group by
        stop_id,
        service_date_mst,
        event_hour_mst
),
route_mode as (
    select
        stop_id,
        service_date_mst,
        event_hour_mst,
        array_agg(route_id order by route_events desc, route_id limit 1)[offset(0)] as route_id_mode
    from (
        select
            stop_id,
            service_date_mst,
            event_hour_mst,
            route_id,
            count(*) as route_events
        from base
        where route_id is not null
        group by
            stop_id,
            service_date_mst,
            event_hour_mst,
            route_id
    )
    group by
        stop_id,
        service_date_mst,
        event_hour_mst
)

select
    a.stop_id,
    a.service_date_mst,
    a.event_hour_mst,
    a.n_events,
    a.pct_on_time,
    a.mean_delay_sec,
    a.p90_delay_sec,
    coalesce(rm.route_id_mode, 'unknown') as route_id_mode,
    h.headway_adherence_rate,
    h.obs_headway_sec_p50,
    h.obs_headway_sec_p90,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at,
    s.stop_name,
    s.lat,
    s.lon,
    r.route_name as route_name_mode,
    a.data_version,
    a.n_reported_events,
    a.pct_within_30s,

    safe_divide(sum(h * h), 2 * sum(h)) - safe_divide(sum(s * s), 2 * sum(s)) as excess_wait_sec,
    avg(if(h is null, null, if(h < 0.25 * s, 1, 0))) as pct_bunched,

with headways as (

        avg(if(h is null, null, if(h < 0.25 * s, 1, 0))) as pct_bunched,

        avg(if(

    from `whyline-denver`.`mart_denver`.`mart_crash_proximity_by_stop`

    from v

        0.5 * coalesce(vuln_score_0_100, 0)

    from joined

with routes as (
    select route_id, route_name, route_long_name
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`dim_route`
    where is_latest_version and route_id is not null
),
schedule as (
    select
        route_id,
        logical_and(is_frequent_route) as is_frequent_route,
        min(if(day_type = 'weekday', first_departure, null)) as weekday_first_departure,
        max(if(day_type = 'weekday', last_departure, null)) as weekday_last_departure,
        avg(if(day_type = 'weekday', headway_midday_min, null)) as weekday_midday_headway_min
    from `whyline-denver`.`mart_denver`.`mart_frequent_network_by_route`
    group by 1
),
reliability as (
    select
        route_id,
        count(*) as n_visits_measured,
        avg(if(delay_sec is null, null,
            if(delay_sec > -60 and delay_sec <= 300, 1, 0))) as pct_on_time,
        safe_divide(
            sum(if(scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, pow(observed_headway_sec, 2), null)),
            2 * sum(if(scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, observed_headway_sec, null))
        ) - safe_divide(
            sum(if(observed_headway_sec is not null and scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, pow(scheduled_headway_sec, 2), null)),
            2 * sum(if(observed_headway_sec is not null and scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, scheduled_headway_sec, null))
        ) as excess_wait_sec
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_stop_headway`
    where service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 28 day) and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
    group by 1
),
delivery as (
    select
        route_id,
        sum(n_scheduled) as n_trips_scheduled,
        sum(n_observable) as n_trips_observable,
        safe_divide(sum(pct_delivered * n_observable), sum(if(pct_delivered is null, 0, n_observable))) as pct_delivered,
        safe_divide(sum(pct_missed_likely * n_observable), sum(if(pct_missed_likely is null, 0, n_observable)))
            as pct_missed_likely
    from `whyline-denver`.`mart_denver`.`mart_service_delivered_by_route_day`
    where service_date_mst between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 28 day) and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
    group by 1
),
predictions as (
    select
        route_id,
        avg(if(has_prediction and horizon_bucket = '0-3', if(within_band, 1, 0), null)) as pct_predictions_accurate_0_3
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_prediction_accuracy`
    where service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 28 day) and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
    group by 1
),
crowding as (
    select
        route_id,
        count(*) as n_trips_with_occupancy,
        avg(if(trip_level >= 3, 1, 0)) as pct_trips_standing_or_worse
    from (
        select service_date, trip_id, any_value(route_id) as route_id, max(max_level) as trip_level
        from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_trip_occupancy`
        where service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 28 day) and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
        group by 1, 2
    )
    where trip_level is not null
    group by 1
),
runtime as (
    select
        route_id,
        sum(n_trips) as n_trips_timed,
        round(safe_divide(sum(buffer_time_index * n_trips), sum(n_trips)), 3) as buffer_time_index
    from `whyline-denver`.`mart_denver`.`mart_trip_runtime_by_route_day`
    where service_date_mst between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 28 day) and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
    group by 1
),
alerts as (
    select route_id, round(sum(alert_hours), 1) as alert_hours
    from `whyline-denver`.`mart_denver`.`mart_alerts_by_route_day`
    where service_date_mst between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 28 day) and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
    group by 1
)

select
    r.route_id,
    r.route_name,
    r.route_long_name,
    s.is_frequent_route,
    s.weekday_first_departure,
    s.weekday_last_departure,
    round(s.weekday_midday_headway_min, 1) as weekday_midday_headway_min,
    rl.n_visits_measured,
    rl.pct_on_time,
    rl.excess_wait_sec,
    d.n_trips_scheduled,
    d.n_trips_observable,
    d.pct_delivered,
    d.pct_missed_likely,
    p.pct_predictions_accurate_0_3,
    c.n_trips_with_occupancy,
    c.pct_trips_standing_or_worse,
    rt.n_trips_timed,
    rt.buffer_time_index,
    a.alert_hours,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from routes as r

left join predictions as p using (route_id)
left join crowding as c using (route_id)

with lane_segments as (
    select from_stop_id, to_stop_id, corridor, lane_type, year_built
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`bridge_segment_transit_lane`
),
traversals as (
    select
        t.*,
        date_trunc(t.service_date, week(monday)) as week_start,
        case
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 4 and 6 then 'early'
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 7 and 8 then 'am_peak'
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 9 and 14 then 'midday'
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 15 and 17 then 'pm_peak'
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 18 and 20 then 'evening'
            else 'night'
        end as period,
        safe_divide(t.travel_sec, nullif(t.scheduled_travel_sec, 0)) as delay_ratio
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_segment_traversal` as t
),
on_lane as (
    select distinct l.corridor, t.route_id
    from traversals as t
    join lane_segments as l
        on l.from_stop_id = t.from_stop_id and l.to_stop_id = t.to_stop_id
),
grouped as (
    -- The corridor's own lane segments.
    select l.corridor, 'lane' as segment_group, t.week_start, t.period, t.speed_kmh, t.delay_ratio
    from traversals as t
    join (select distinct from_stop_id, to_stop_id, corridor from lane_segments) as l
        on l.from_stop_id = t.from_stop_id and l.to_stop_id = t.to_stop_id
    union all
    -- The same routes elsewhere, on segments with no lane at all.
    select r.corridor, 'same_routes_no_lane', t.week_start, t.period, t.speed_kmh, t.delay_ratio
    from traversals as t
    join on_lane as r
        on r.route_id = t.route_id
    where not exists (
        select 1 from lane_segments as l
        where l.from_stop_id = t.from_stop_id and l.to_stop_id = t.to_stop_id
    )
),
lane_years as (
    select corridor, min(year_built) as first_year_built, max(year_built) as last_year_built
    from lane_segments
    group by 1
)

select

    any_value(y.first_year_built) as first_year_built,
    any_value(y.last_year_built) as last_year_built,
    
    cast(null as int64) as weeks_since_opening,
    
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from grouped as g
left join lane_years as y

group by 1, 2, 3, 4
